query: Test the app on the emulator
expected_behavior: Fetches from origin and confirms the branch is up to date before building
Runs scripts/emulator.sh, then scripts/install.sh debug --fresh, without reading the scripts first
Goes through the first-run picker and at least the dashboard, practice and About flows from reference/test-plan.md, reading a screenshot of each screen
Ends with the report table, including a 'Not tested' line

query: I'm about to upload to Play. Check the release build works on the simulator.
expected_behavior: Installs with scripts/install.sh release --fresh (R8 build signed with the debug key), not the debug build
Runs the smoke test, covering screens that load bundled content and a relaunch to check saved progress
Runs scripts/check_crash.sh release after each flow and reports any SerializationException or ClassNotFoundException as an R8 problem

query: Check the About screen looks right in French and in dark mode
expected_behavior: Opens About with `android input tap desc=About` (it is a content description, not text)
Switches language with the FR toggle or cmd locale set-app-locales, and dark theme with cmd uimode night yes
Reads the screenshots and compares them with design/mockup/, flagging clipped or untranslated text
Resets language and night mode afterwards
